data.title: Added live-model retries; all 418 backend tests pass. Rerunning 36 request cases with reduced parallelism; evaluation remains in progress.

evidence: All 418 backend tests pass with the retrying model client. Now I'll rerun the full set of 36 cases, with less parallelism to avoid overloading the API.

data.spec: Optional integer environment variable OFFICE_MODEL_MAX_RETRIES defaults to 6. Configures Anthropic SDK retries for live model calls used by agent.py and conversation.py.
